title: MemoryCeilingSnapshot
description: Zero-overhead kernel memory snapshot capturing resident, high-water mark peak RSS, and virtual memory metrics.

currentRSSBytes.description: Instantaneous physical resident set size (RSS) in bytes.

peakRSSBytes.description: Lifetime peak resident set size (kernel high-water mark) in bytes.

virtualSizeBytes.description: Total virtual address space size allocated by the process in bytes.

sampledTimestampMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when telemetry was captured.
